arguments.summary: A critical security incident was initiated from host WS-FIN-042 (IP: 10.0.5.42), attributed to user CORP\jsmith in the Finance department. The host was compromised via a phishing email leading to execution of a Cobalt Strike beacon. Lateral movement was attempted via SMB to a file server. The attacker performed reconnaissance and attempted credential theft. Actions taken include full host scan and remediation via Ansible, user credential reset, and MFA re-enrollment. No data exfiltration was confirmed.

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTPS_Pattern {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing over HTTPS based on request pattern and headers"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        miter_ids = ["T1071.001"]
    strings:
        $beacon_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $host_header = /Host:.+\.com/ ascii
        $user_agent = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" ascii
        $accept_lang = "Accept-Language: en-US" ascii
    condition:
        all of ($beacon*) and filesize < 500KB
}
